title: Apple priority for US10852553B2 'Electronic device with a tunable lens' (vision correction, not camera)
detail: Apple priority for US10852553B2 'Electronic device with a tunable lens' (granted 2020-12-01) — fluid-filled varifocal lens for vision correction in a head-mounted device, not a camera.

title: Apple provisional 63/499,906 → KR20250169234A tunable see-through lens (prescription, not camera AF)
detail: Apple provisional 63/499,906 → KR20250169234A 'Tunable lens adjustment in electronic devices' (Stamenov et al.; pub 2025-12-02): fluid-filled see-through lens with prescription/presbyopia modes in an HMD — vision correction, not camera AF.

title: Apple introduces Vision Pro at WWDC: US$3,499, 12 cameras + 5 sensors
detail: Apple newsroom: Vision Pro announced with 12 cameras, 5 sensors, 6 microphones, M2 + R1 chips, "available early next year" in the U.S. with more countries "later that year".

title: Apple priority for US20250028094A1 'Fluid-Filled Tunable Lens' with ex-CML CTO Richard Topliss as inventor
detail: Apple priority for US20250028094A1 'Fluid-Filled Tunable Lens' (inventors incl. Richard J. Topliss, ex-CML CTO; filed 2024-06-12; pub 2025-01-23) — periphery fluid bladders deform a see-through lens in an HMD (vision correction).

title: Apple sets Vision Pro U.S. pre-orders 2024-01-19, availability 2024-02-02 at US$3,499
detail: Apple newsroom: R1 "processes input from 12 cameras, five sensors, and six microphones"; 256GB at US$3,499.

title: Apple Vision Pro ships in the U.S. (242 days after announcement)
detail: First shipments of Vision Pro in the United States, 242 days after the WWDC 2023 announcement.

title: iFixit Vision Pro teardown: 12 cameras + LiDAR + TrueDepth; no module supplier or actuator identified
detail: iFixit's Vision Pro teardown counted 12 cameras plus LiDAR and TrueDepth processed by the R1 chip; no camera-module supplier or AF actuator was identified.

title: Apple priority for WO2025193343A1 'Tunable lens with shape memory alloy actuators' (see-through Rx lens)
detail: Apple priority for WO2025193343A1 'Tunable lens with shape memory alloy actuators' (Burbridge; pub 2025-09-18): four SMA actuators drive a gear/screw to deform a fluid-filled see-through lens in an HMD (vision correction, not camera). Follow-up WO2025240226A1

title: Apple announces Vision Pro international expansion (June 28 / July 12 waves)
detail: China mainland/HK/Japan/Singapore pre-orders 2024-06-13, availability 2024-06-28; Australia/Canada/France/Germany/UK pre-orders 2024-06-28, availability 2024-07-12; visionOS 2 "this fall".

title: Vision Pro ships in China mainland, Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore
detail: First international wave, roughly 5 months after the U.S. launch.

title: Vision Pro ships in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, UK
detail: Second international wave of Vision Pro availability.

title: visionOS 2 released (98 days after WWDC 2024 announcement)
detail: Apple newsroom: visionOS 2 available for Vision Pro; announced at WWDC on 2024-06-10.

title: Kuo: Apple tethered display-accessory glasses "paused in Q4 2024, under review"
detail: Kuo note of 2025-06-30 (via AppleInsider): Mac/iPhone-tethered glasses with birdbath optics, electrochromic dimming, 120-130 g were paused because weight exceeded sub-100 g competitors.

title: Apple tethered display glasses project "cancelled in January 2025" (Bloomberg recap)
detail: AppleInsider's June 2026 synthesis of Bloomberg reporting states the tethered display glasses project was cancelled in January 2025.

title: TrendForce: Apple designing smart-glasses chip at TSMC, MP by end-2026 or 2027
detail: TrendForce (citing Bloomberg/The Information/Commercial Times): Apple-Watch-derived chip handling multiple cameras; product described as "non-AR glasses that use cameras to scan the environment"; mass production "by the end of next year or in 2027".

title: Gurman: Apple N50 glasses targeted end-2026; prototype volumes with overseas suppliers end-2025
detail: Bloomberg (Gurman): Apple targets N50 glasses (project N401) by "end of 2026"; will "start producing large quantities of prototypes at the end of this year with overseas suppliers"; "cameras, microphones and speakers"; "similar to the Meta product but better m

title: Kuo roadmap: Apple camera glasses MP Q2 2027, 3-5M+ units 2027; XR glasses H2 2028
detail: [Verification: partially supported — AppleInsider 30 Jun 2025: Ray-Ban-style glasses MP Q2 2027, 'three to five million or more in 2027', no display, audio/video, 'AI environmental sensing', XR glasses MP H2 2028. Vision Pro M5, 'Vision Air' and late-2028 Visi

title: visionOS 26 released (announced WWDC 2025-06-09)
detail: MacRumors: Apple releases visionOS 26 on 2025-09-15, continuing the mid-September release cadence.

title: Gurman: Apple pauses Vision Air, moves engineers to glasses; reveal "as soon as 2026"
detail: Bloomberg (Gurman): Apple "hit pause" on Vision Air (was 2027) and moved its engineers to the glasses; display-less glasses reveal pulled to "as soon as next year" (2026) ahead of a 2027 release; display glasses, originally 2028, now aimed at "potentially 2027

title: Apple introduces Vision Pro with M5 chip; availability 2025-10-22 from US$3,499
detail: Apple newsroom: Vision Pro with M5 chip and Dual Knit Band; demos bookable same day; nationwide availability 2025-10-22.

title: Vision Pro (M5) available, 7 days after announcement
detail: Silicon-swap refresh; "other specifications remain unchanged" per Kuo.

title: 9to5Mac/TrendForce: Apple AI glasses to be unveiled 2026, ship 2027, multiple cameras
detail: Report (unnamed sources): AI glasses with "multiple cameras enabling visual-intelligence features"; S-class Apple Watch chip; processing offloaded to iPhone; higher-end display model later.

title: FT/IDC: Apple cuts Vision Pro production; 45,000 units Q4 2025 vs ~390,000 in 2024
detail: FT: Apple cut Vision Pro production and slashed U.S./UK digital ad spend by >95%; IDC estimates 45,000 units shipped in Q4 2025; IDC says contract manufacturer Luxshare stopped production at the start of 2025.

title: Bloomberg (Gurman): Apple glasses with two cameras, mass production Dec 2026, launch early 2027
detail: Bloomberg's Gurman (via UploadVR) reported Apple glasses would have two cameras (capture + computer vision), with mass production targeted for December 2026 and launch in early 2027; no suppliers named.

title: Gurman: Apple N50 glasses slip to late-2027 release; US$200-500 price band
detail: Gurman "Power On": N50 slips from "end of 2026 reveal / early 2027 launch" to a late-2027 release ("some bumps on the road"); vertically oriented oval camera lenses; four frame styles under test; black/ocean blue/light brown.

title: Kuo: Apple waveguide display glasses pushed to 2029; AI glasses on schedule for 2027
detail: Kuo: display-less AI glasses "remain on schedule for a 2027 launch" per supply-chain checks; "a major overhaul of the product line that removed the Vision Pro line", approved by incoming CEO John Ternus; AAPL -2%.

title: AppleInsider synthesis: Vision Pro "on ice", AI glasses end-2027, display glasses 2029
detail: Synthesis of Gurman/Kuo: Vision Pro not formally discontinued, follow-up in testing; Vision Air killed Oct 2025; display glasses cancelled Jan 2025; remaining roadmap = AI glasses end-2027, waveguide display glasses 2029, full AR glasses end of decade.

title: Apple WWDC 2026 (week of June 8)
detail: Apple's Worldwide Developers Conference 2026, week of June 8 (2026-06-08 to 06-12); see Apple file.

title: Gurman: Apple N50 unveil WWDC June 2027, ships by end-2027; two cameras (capture + CV)
detail: [Verification: partially supported — MacRumors 26 Jul 2026 (Gurman): unveil WWDC 2027, ship 'late 2027', privacy features, camera options considered. N50, 'priority No. 1', two-sensor (capture + computer vision) design and display timing not in cited article;

title: visionOS 27 released (third consecutive mid-September release)
detail: 9to5Mac: visionOS 27 launches 2026-09-14.

title: Gurman: Apple glasses still end-2027; N224 headset late 2028/early 2029 on "life support"
detail: Gurman "Power On": first glasses (no display; audio, camera, video recording, AI sensing) still end-2027; revamped headset N224 "late 2028 or early 2029" if launched, four concepts incl. offloading components to a puck.
